findings.description: Sections 2–4 do not form a complete discourse: section 2 gives only Mai’s request to staff, section 3 asserts that Mai asked staff, and section 4 asks ‘What did staff say?’, but no staff reply is supplied. The required listening answer therefore cannot be recovered from the lesson’s own model.
findings.recommendation: Add a brief staff reply containing the confirmed bus, time, and gate, then keep Mai’s mediation and the final listening question aligned with that reply.
